in_marathi.name: Vikal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Defiant, Brave, Victorious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'vikalpa' meaning 'to deviate, to defy'. The name is a symbol of courage, strength, and intelligence. It signifies one who is victorious in life, despite facing challenges and adversities.
